title: Tensile creep behavior of the Nb45Ta25Ti15Hf15 refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting high-purity elemental refractory metals (99.95%+ purity) under 1×10−5 torr vacuum with Ti gettering, followed by flipping and remelting five times for homogeneity. The material underwent 90% thickness reduction via cold rolling to 0.6 mm thickness, then annealed at 1373 K for 1 hour in stainless steel bags to minimize oxygen and nitrogen absorption.
